learning_objective: 🎯 Become a responsible digital citizen! Understand cyber safety, data privacy, intellectual property, and the environmental impact of technology.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Every time you go online, you leave a trail of data (websites visited, emails sent, posts liked). This is your digital footprint, and it is permanent. Always think before you post!
IPR protects creations of the mind (inventions, art, software). It includes Copyright (protects art/literature), Patents (protects inventions), and Trademarks (protects logos/brands).
Stealing someone else's work or ideas (like copying a Wikipedia article for your homework) and passing it off as your own without giving them proper credit.
Crimes committed using a computer and internet. It includes Hacking (unauthorized access), Phishing (fake emails trying to steal passwords), and Cyberbullying.
Discarded electronic devices (old phones, laptops) contain toxic chemicals. Improper disposal harms the environment. E-waste must be recycled properly through authorized centers.

fun_activity.title: 🕵️ The Fake Email Check
fun_activity.instructions: Imagine you get an email saying 'You won a lottery! Click here and log in with your bank password to claim.' What is this cyberattack called? (Hint: It involves 'fishing' for your details!).

exam_tips: 📌 Distinguish clearly between Copyright (for creative works like books/code), Patent (for new inventions), and Trademark (for brand names/logos).
📌 Know the difference between active digital footprints (things you post intentionally) and passive digital footprints (data collected without you knowing, like IP addresses).
📌 FOSS stands for Free and Open Source Software (software where anyone can see and modify the source code).
quick_recap: ⭐ Netiquette refers to the proper and polite way to behave and communicate on the internet.
⭐ A strong password should be long, contain a mix of letters, numbers, and symbols, and never be shared.
⭐ Using a computer with proper posture and screen distance prevents health hazards like eye strain and back pain.
